summary: Invisible lockdown. A dry, ultra-fine aerosol hairspray that provides flexible hold and memory without stickiness.
description: Atmospheric resistance. This high-tech formula uses advanced copolymers to create an invisible, weightless web around the hairstyle, repelling humidity and locking in architecture while maintaining touchable movement.
technical_overview: Offered at $24.0 for 250ml, this KoColor HAIR_SPRAY is expertly formulated with Alcohol Denat, VA/Crotonates/Vinyl Neodecanoate Copolymer, and Aminomethyl Propanol. It delivers a high-fidelity Invisible Hold color profile (`#FFFFFF`) and leverages dry-aerosol webbing.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Hold 12 inches from the head and spray in short, sweeping bursts over finished styles.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Spray directly onto a clean mascara wand and brush over the hairline to permanently neutralize flyaways.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: The ultra-dry alcohol carrier evaporates before hitting the hair, ensuring zero moisture disrupts your heat-styled architecture.
